waivers.reason: D6 is a dual ESD clamp in SOT-23 on B.Cu (issue #133, docs/boards/core-esd.md). hwde's cpl_verify does not model JLC's bottom-side convention, so every bottom part is 'bottom_unverified'. Pins 1 and 2 are identical bidirectional channels to the common pin 3, so a mirror that swaps 1 and 2 changes nothing. What matters is that pin 3 lands on the lone pad (GND): confirm that in JLC's bottom-side preview at order.
